name: web-design-reviewer
summary: Agent skill that visually reviews a running website and fixes layout, responsive and contrast issues in its source.
description: A GitHub Copilot agent skill: it opens a running target site (local dev server, staging or production), checks it at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1280px) and wide (1920px) viewports, flags layout overflow, alignment, responsive breakpoints and accessibility contrast issues, then applies minimal fixes in the source — up to three attempts per issue, with before/after screenshot comparison. Works with static sites, SPAs (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte), Next.js/Nuxt/SvelteKit and CMS platforms.
contains: detects layout overflow, alignment, contrast and responsive issues
applies source-level fixes, up to 3 attempts per issue
supports static sites, SPA frameworks, full-stack frameworks and CMS platforms
requires a running target site and workspace access
